name: Chin Ch’ang-hsü
bio: Chin Ch’ang-hsü is placed in the 10th century AD in the Chronology of the Poets in Bynner’s The Jade Mountain.
The poems here are Witter Bynner’s versions, from the texts of Kiang Kang-hu, in The Jade Mountain (1929).

poems.title: A Spring Sigh
poems.author: Chin Ch’ang-hsü
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
Drive the orioles away,
All their music from the trees. . . .
When she dreamed that she went to Liao-hsi Camp
To join him there, they wakened her.
